android_metadata|CREATE TABLE android_metadata (locale TEXT)

sqlite_sequence|CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
categories|CREATE TABLE `categories` (`categoryId` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT)
recipes_with_categories|CREATE TABLE `recipes_with_categories` (`recipeId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `categoryId` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`recipeId`, `categoryId`), FOREIGN KEY(`recipeId`) REFERENCES `recipes`(`recipeId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY(`categoryId`) REFERENCES `categories`(`categoryId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )
recipes_fts|CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE `recipes_fts` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT, `description` TEXT, `source` TEXT, `ingredients` TEXT, tokenize=unicode61 `tokenchars=#`, content=`recipes`)
